1406.6: Swayye in praise of the Fifth Guru (Guru Arjan Dev Ji). Ik Oankar: God is One, the all-pervading Creator, realised through the True Guru's grace. I remember that same Being, unmoving and imperishable, remembering whom the filth of evil understanding is destroyed. I enshrine the True Guru's lotus feet in my heart, and in Sahaj I reflect on the virtues of Guru Arjan. He has shone forth in the house of Guru Ram Das, and every longing and hope has been fulfilled. (O Guru Arjan,) from birth you have recognised God through the Guru's teaching; Kal, with palms joined, has spoken your fair praise. The Lord has made him a Janak, victorious in the yoga of devotion; he has made the Shabad, the Guru, shine forth, and has set the Lord upon his tongue. Holding fast to Gurus Nanak, Angad and Amar (Das), he has attained the highest state. In the house of Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan has come down (into the world) as the Lord's devotee. ॥1॥
1407.1: Greatly fortunate, he dwells in the state of unman, and has enshrined the Shabad in his heart. His mind, a ruby, is content; the Guru has made the Name firm (in him). The True Guru has shown (him) the Supreme Lord, unreachable, beyond the senses. In the house of Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan has been established as the embodiment of the direct knowing (of God). ॥2॥
1407.2: He has made the rule of Janak prevail; the Satjug has set in. Through the Guru's Shabad his mind is won over; the mind that would not be appeased is appeased. Guru Nanak, having laid the foundation of Truth, is merged with the True Guru. In the house of Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan has become (the form of) the Infinite beyond the beyond. ॥3॥
1407.3: The Sovereign Lord has staged a deep play: (Guru Arjan) lives in contentment, and pure understanding is absorbed in the True Guru. (He is the form of the Lord,) unborn and self-existent; Kal and the poets have spoken his fair praise. Guru Nanak blessed Angad; Guru Angad (blessed) Amar (Das), the treasure-house; Guru Ram Das blessed Arjan, (whose) touch is truly the touch of the paaras. ॥4॥
1407.4: Ever-living is (Guru) Arjan, priceless, unborn and self-existent; he breaks fear, ends the sorrows of others, is boundless, and knows (God) directly. He has grasped the Ungraspable; he burns away doubt and wandering; he is cool, and a giver of peace. The Self-existent, the Perfect Being, the Creator, has come forth. (By the grace of Guru) Nanak first, and of Angad and Amar (Das), he is merged in the True Guru's Shabad. Blessed, blessed is Guru Ram Das, the Guru, the paaras who touched (Guru Arjan) and made him one with himself. ॥5॥
1407.5: He whose victory is hailed throughout the world, in whose house fortune dwells, who stays joined with the gracious Lord; who by great fortune has found the Perfect Guru, whose attention is fixed (on God), who bears the burden of the earth; who breaks fear and takes away the pain of others: (O Guru,) Kalsahar speaks your praise: he is (Guru) Arjan, of the Sodhi clan, the son of Guru Ram Das, the banner of righteousness, the Lord's devotee. ॥6॥
1407.6: Steadfast in righteousness, deep in the Guru's teaching, he makes others forget their sorrow. Excellent in the Shabad, generous like the Lord, he drives out egotism. A great giver, rich in the True Guru's wisdom, the zeal in his mind never flags. He is true; the mantra of the Lord's Name, (his) nine treasures, never runs out. The son of Guru Ram Das is (one with) the all-pervading Lord; in Sahaj he has spread out his canopy. Kal says: O Guru Arjan, you have known the delight of Raj and Jog. ॥7॥
1408.1: In (God's) fear he has enjoyed the Fearless One; within the lakhs (of beings) he has shown the Unseen. The True Guru has made him at home with the Unreachable, the One beyond the senses, whose state is deep. At one with the Guru, he is approved; amid sovereignty he has practised Jog. Blessed, blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has filled the empty pools (of hearts) to the brim. Reaching the Guru's state, he has borne the unbearable, and is merged in the pool of contentment. Kal says: O Guru Arjan, you have attained, in Sahaj, your own true union (with God). ॥8॥
1408.2: Amrit is on your tongue, and the gift of blessing in your mouth; O unseen, infinite, heroic Guru, by the Shabad you have driven out Haumai. You have crushed the five deer (of the senses), and in Sahaj you have held the Absolute in your own home (within). Attached to the Lord's Name, the world has been saved; you have enshrined the True Guru in your heart. Kal says: O Guru Arjan, you have made the golden pinnacle of Janak shine. ॥9॥
Kalas: the golden finial crowning a temple or palace.
1408.3: Sorathe (a metre). Guru Arjan is the approved Being; like Parth (Arjun), he does not waver (in the field). The Name is his spear and his standard; the True Guru's Shabad has adorned him. ॥1॥
Parth: Arjun of the Mahabharata (son of Pritha), who did not waver in battle.
1408.4: The world is an ocean; the Lord's Name is the bridge and the ship. You love the True Guru; attached to the Name, the world has been saved. ॥2॥
1408.5: The Name that saves the world has been obtained by the True Guru's favour. Now I have nothing to do with any other; at (your) door my every need is met. ॥3॥
1408.6: The Lord himself, in the form of light, was called Guru Nanak. (Guru) Angad sprang from him, (his) essence merged with the Essence. (Guru) Angad, showing grace, established Amar (Das) firmly as the True Guru. Amar Das gave the immortal royal canopy to Guru Ram (Das). Mathura says: from the sight and touch of Guru Ram Das, (Guru Arjan's) words have become Amrit; behold with your eyes Guru Arjan, the fifth form, the approved Being. ॥1॥
1408.7: He has enshrined in his heart (the Lord), whose form is True and whose Name is True, and truth and contentment. The Primal Being has plainly written the letter (of destiny) on his forehead from the very beginning. (God's) light blazes forth, made manifest (in him); his radiance has spread over the earth. Having touched the paaras (the Guru), touched the one worthy of touch, he has been named Guru by the Guru. Mathura says: fix your mind on (his) ever-abiding form, and stay facing (him). In the Kalyug Guru Arjan is the ship: all creation, hold fast (to him) and cross over. ॥2॥
1408.8: Beg from that servant (of God), known throughout the world, whose dwelling day and night, and whose love, is with the Name; who is wholly detached, dyed in the colour of the Supreme God, beyond all craving, yet is seen to keep a home; whose love is set on the Infinite Being, beyond the beyond, and who, apart from the Lord, finds relish in no other work. Mathura's Lord, who pervades all, is Guru Arjan; for love of devotion he stays at Ram's feet, one with him. ॥3॥
1409.1: All the gods and sages do not find (his) end, nor Indra, nor great Shiva, who practised yoga; and Biranchi grew weary pondering the Vedas, never leaving the Lord's repetition for a moment. The Lord of his servant Mathura is merciful to the meek; he has made the Sangat and the world rejoice. To carry the world across, Guru Ram Das has placed the Guru's light in (Guru) Arjan. ॥4॥
1409.2: In this great darkness of the world there is no other; (the Lord) has brought him and made him a radiant incarnation. Millions of sorrows have left them, O Mathura, who have drunk the Amrit of the Name. O mind, do not stray from this path; think of no difference or division, and do not take (him) for a second. Manifestly, the Lord, the Perfect Brahm, has made his dwelling in Guru Arjan's heart. ॥5॥
1409.3: As long as the fortune on (our) foreheads had not risen, (we) roamed and wandered, running here and there. We were drowning in the terrible ocean of the Kalyug, and (our) remorse would never end. O Mathura, this is the essential truth: to carry the world across, (the Lord) has made this incarnation. Those who have meditated on Guru Arjan Dev have not come again into the pain of births and the womb. ॥6॥
1409.4: In the ocean of the Kalyug (Guru Arjan) has come in manifest form, the Lord's Name, which saves; he in whose heart the Sants dwell is the remover of sorrow and poverty. He is the pure form of the Infinite; apart from him there is no other. Whoever has known him in mind and word has become like him. In the earth, the sky and the nine regions, he, in the form of light, pervades all. Mathura says: there is no difference at all; Guru Arjan is the Lord made manifest. ॥7॥
1409.5: (At the Guru's court flows) the unconquerable, unfailing water of the Ganga, in which the whole Sangat of Sikhs bathes. The Puranas are read (there) every day, and Brahma sings the Vedas with his mouth. An unconquerable whisk waves over his head; he has taken the Amrit of the Name upon his lips. The Supreme God himself has set the royal canopy over Guru Arjan's head. Joining the Gurus Nanak, Angad and Amar (Das), Guru Ram Das has gone to the Lord. O Harbans, his glory spreads through the world: who can say that the revered Guru has died? ॥1॥
Harbans too is one of the Bhatts.
1409.6: He has gone to the city of the gods (the Lord's realm), as it pleased the Supreme God himself. The Lord gave (him) a throne, and seated the revered Guru on it. The gods rejoiced; they sing your praise and hail your victory. The demons fled, their sins trembling within them. The sins of those men are cut away who have found Guru Ram Das. To Guru Arjan he has handed over the royal canopy and the throne of the earth, and gone. ॥2॥
